entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

details.flavorMarkdown: *An armed burial guardian in tarnished armor, with turf caught in its shield and remnants of an oath worked into its clothing. It remembers its duty more clearly than its life.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Oath blade

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Push 2. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

### Shield Hunker

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, impose 1 Bane on player attacks this shield can block until the start of its next turn. The DA judges blockability. Uses its Reaction; stacks with Defend, not another activation of itself.

### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Every disturbed grave has been filled in again from within.

**Purpose:** Keep the sworn burial place intact.

**Tactics and retreat:** Shield Hunker at the tomb entrance and push desecrators back.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Return stolen grave goods or show permission from the rightful heir.

**Habitat:** Barrow; ancient road · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Melee weapon, shield and burial jewelry worth 30 coins if legitimately recovered.

**Summoning:** Undead 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/summons/barrow-guard.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-barrow-guard


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Defender · **CV:** 25

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.25 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=4.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [barrow guard plant the shield](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/barrow-guard-plant-the-shield.md), [Cover a Companion](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/cover-a-companion.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [shield hunker](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/shield-hunker.md).

[Roster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/roster.md) · [Agreed Stability](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/rules/stability.md)
